table.name: Breeds
table.purpose: Lookup table of dog breeds, keyed by a three-letter breed code and referenced by Dogs.breed_code. One row per breed (Eskimo, Husky, Bulldog).

breed_code.name: breed_code
breed_code.description: Primary key. Three-letter abbreviation of the breed (ESK=Eskimo, HUS=Husky, BUL=Bulldog). Referenced by Dogs.breed_code.

breed_name.name: breed_name
breed_name.description: Full name of the dog breed corresponding to the breed code.

table.name: Charges
table.purpose: Lookup/price list of charge types (Daily Accommodation, Drugs, Health Check) with an associated amount, presumably in whole currency units (e.g. dollars) charged by the shelter.

charge_amount.name: charge_amount
charge_amount.description: Amount charged for the charge type, in whole currency units (98-640).

charge_id.name: charge_id
charge_id.description: Primary key of the charge type.

charge_type.name: charge_type
charge_type.description: Name of the charge type, e.g. Daily Accommodation, Drugs, Health Check.

table.name: Dogs
table.purpose: Registry of dogs at an animal shelter: each row is one dog with its breed, size, physical attributes, arrival/adoption/departure dates, and the owner who adopted it. Referenced by Treatments.

abandoned_yn.name: abandoned_yn
abandoned_yn.description: Flag indicating whether the dog was abandoned (1 = abandoned, 0 = not).

age.name: age
age.description: Age of the dog, in years (values 1-9).

breed_code.name: breed_code
breed_code.description: Foreign key to Breeds.breed_code identifying the dog's breed.

date_adopted.name: date_adopted
date_adopted.description: Timestamp when the dog was adopted (Feb-Mar 2018).

date_arrived.name: date_arrived
date_arrived.description: Timestamp when the dog arrived at the shelter (Apr 2017 - Jan 2018).

date_departed.name: date_departed
date_departed.description: Timestamp when the dog left the shelter (late Mar 2018), presumably on adoption or other departure.

date_of_birth.name: date_of_birth
date_of_birth.description: Date of birth of the dog (2008-2018).

dog_id.name: dog_id
dog_id.description: Primary key identifying the dog. Referenced by Treatments.dog_id.

gender.name: gender
gender.description: Binary gender flag (0/1); which value maps to male vs female is not determinable from the data.

owner_id.name: owner_id
owner_id.description: Foreign key to Owners.owner_id, the person who adopted/owns the dog.

size_code.name: size_code
size_code.description: Foreign key to Sizes.size_code identifying the dog's size category (SML=Small, MED=Medium, LGE=Large).

weight.name: weight
weight.description: Weight of the dog, a decimal value 1.39-9.8; unit not stated (likely kg).

table.name: Owners
table.purpose: Contact records for dog owners (adopters): name, address, phone numbers and email. One row per owner; referenced by Dogs.owner_id.

cell_number.name: cell_number
cell_number.description: Mobile phone number of the owner, in varied formats (with extensions).

home_phone.name: home_phone
home_phone.description: Home/landline phone number of the owner, in varied formats.

owner_id.name: owner_id
owner_id.description: Primary key identifying the owner. Referenced by Dogs.owner_id.

state.name: state
state.description: US state of the owner's address (written without spaces, e.g. NewYork, NorthDakota).

street.name: street
street.description: Street portion of the owner's address (number plus street/apartment).

zip_code.name: zip_code
zip_code.description: US ZIP code of the owner's address (5-digit, stored with leading zeros).

table.name: Professionals
table.purpose: Staff of the shelter/veterinary practice: contact details plus a role (Veterinarian or Employee). One row per professional; referenced by Treatments.professional_id.

cell_number.name: cell_number
cell_number.description: Mobile phone number of the professional, in varied formats.

home_phone.name: home_phone
home_phone.description: Home phone number of the professional, in varied formats.

professional_id.name: professional_id
professional_id.description: Primary key identifying the professional. Referenced by Treatments.professional_id.

role_code.name: role_code
role_code.description: Job role of the professional: 'Veterenarian' (sic, misspelled Veterinarian) or 'Employee'.

state.name: state
state.description: US state of the professional's address (written without spaces, e.g. NorthCarolina).

street.name: street
street.description: Street portion of the professional's address; some values embed a second line with city/state/ZIP.

zip_code.name: zip_code
zip_code.description: US ZIP code of the professional's address (5-digit, stored with leading zeros).

table.name: Sizes
table.purpose: Lookup table of dog size categories, referenced by Dogs.size_code.

size_code.name: size_code
size_code.description: Primary key; short code for the dog size category (SML, MED, LGE).

size_description.name: size_description
size_description.description: Human-readable label for the size code (Small, Medium, Large).

table.name: Treatment_Types
table.purpose: Lookup table of treatment/service types offered to dogs, referenced by Treatments.treatment_type_code.

treatment_type_code.name: treatment_type_code
treatment_type_code.description: Primary key; short code for the treatment type (EXAM, VAC, WALK).

treatment_type_description.name: treatment_type_description
treatment_type_description.description: Human-readable label for the treatment type (Physical examination, Vaccination, Take for a Walk).

table.name: Treatments
table.purpose: Fact table of individual treatment/service events: which dog received which treatment type, performed by which professional, when, and at what cost.

cost_of_treatment.name: cost_of_treatment
cost_of_treatment.description: Cost of the treatment event; integer amount, range 139-945. Currency unit unknown (no symbol or scale evidence).

date_of_treatment.name: date_of_treatment
date_of_treatment.description: Timestamp of when the treatment was given (stored as text, format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS; range Feb-Mar 2018).

dog_id.name: dog_id
dog_id.description: Foreign key to Dogs.dog_id; the dog that received the treatment.

professional_id.name: professional_id
professional_id.description: Foreign key to Professionals.professional_id; the professional who performed the treatment.

treatment_id.name: treatment_id
treatment_id.description: Primary key; unique identifier of the treatment event.

treatment_type_code.name: treatment_type_code
treatment_type_code.description: Foreign key to Treatment_Types.treatment_type_code; the type of treatment (EXAM, VAC, WALK).
